The '''LCS 2021 Spring''' was the first split of the 2021 season of the [[League of Legends Championship Series]], organized by Riot Games. It took place from February 5 to April 11, 2021, with all matches held online and broadcast from Los Angeles, United States. Ten franchised teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage, followed by a Double Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoff bracket known as the Mid-Season Showdown. The total prize pool was $200,000 USD, and the winner qualified for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2021|2021 Mid-Season Invitational]].

This split marked the introduction of the new LCS season format, which replaced the traditional Spring Playoffs with the Mid-Season Showdown and carried over regular season records into the Summer Split. The competition was played on Patch 11.1 through 11.5, with [[Viego]] disabled throughout the split.

Several North American teams made large roster changes ahead of the new season. [[Golden Guardians]] settled on a deal to sell {{player|Closer|flag=tr}}, {{player|Damonte|flag=us}}, {{player|FBI|flag=au}} and {{player|huhi|flag=kr}} to [[100 Thieves]] <ref name="Closer joins">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/100Thieves/status/1328525983746461696 |title=Welcome @CloserLoL as our starting jungler for the 2021 LCS season! |date=2020-11-17 |author=[[100 Thieves]] |publisher=Twitter |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref><ref name="FBI joins">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/100Thieves/status/1328533383790567424 |title=Welcome FBI (@VictorHuang) as our starting ADC for the 2021 LCS season! |date=2020-11-17 |author=[[100 Thieves]] |publisher=Twitter |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref><ref name="Damonte joins">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/100Thieves/status/1329560174172880897 |title=Welcome @Damonte to 100 Thieves as our starting mid-laner for the 2021 LCS season!|date=2020-11-19 |author=[[100 Thieves]]|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref><ref name="Huhi rejoins">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/100Thieves/status/1329567892598267909 |title=Welcome @Huhi to 100 Thieves as our starting support for the 2021 LCS season!|date=2020-11-19 |author=[[100 Thieves]]|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>. This resulted in [[Golden Guardians]] rebuilding their entire roster, building their roster around rookies because of budget concerns due to the COVID-19 pandemic. [[Cloud9]] acquired the former [[G2 Esports]] player {{player|Perkz|flag=hr}}, a roster move which surprised many in the ''League of Legends'' community <ref name="Perkz joins">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/Cloud9/status/1329847234209345536|title=We are bringing the most accomplished and most impactful Western player in the history of League of Legends to #C9LoL.|date=2020-11-20|author=[[Cloud9]]|publisher=Twitter|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>. [[FlyQuest]] acquired several [[Cloud9]] and [[Cloud9 Academy]] players, with {{player|Licorice|flag=ca}}, {{player|Palafox|flag=us}} and {{player|Diamond|link=Diamond (Canadian player)|flag=ca}} moving to [[FlyQuest]].

Former [[TSM]] midlaner {{player|Bjergsen|flag=dk}} announced his retirement, moving to a coaching position within [[TSM]] <ref name="bjergsen head coach">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/TSM/status/1320032486940958726|title=TSM @Bjergsen announcement|date=2020-10-24|publisher=[[TSM]]|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>. Former [[TSM]] botlaner {{player|Doublelift|flag=us}} announced his retirement later on, retiring after almost 10 years of competition and 8 [[LCS]] titles <ref name="Doublelift retires">{{cite web|url=http://tl.gd/n_1srg0gj|title=Reflections|date-2020-11-25|author=[[Doublelift]]|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>.

===Mid-Season Showdown===
{{#lst:LCS/2021/Spring/Playoffs|Playoffs}}


==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''February 5th - March 14th, 2021''
** Double Round Robin
** Each team plays 18 matches.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st till 4th place''}} advance to the Upper-bracket of Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th and 6th place''}} advance to the Lower-bracket of Playoffs.
** Unlike previous editions, records will be carried over into [[LCS/2021/Summer/Group Stage|LCS Summer Group Stage]]

* '''Playoffs''' - now known as ''Mid Season Showdown'' - ''March 20th - April 11th, 2021''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2021|Mid-Season Invitational 2021]]
